tasks.title: 1. Test User Registration Backend Endpoint
tasks.description: Verify that the user registration endpoint at /api/auth/register is working correctly by testing with valid and invalid data. Check if the backend server is running and properly connected to MongoDB.
tasks.details:
- Start the backend server if not running
- Test registration with valid admission number
- Test registration with manual verification
- Test duplicate email validation
- Test invalid admission number format
- Check database connection and user creation
- Verify response status codes and error messages
tasks.testStrategy: Run backend server, send POST requests to /api/auth/register endpoint with various test cases, verify responses and database entries

tasks.title: 2. Verify Frontend-Backend API Connection
tasks.description: Check that the frontend can successfully communicate with the backend API. Verify CORS settings, API base URL configuration, and network connectivity.
tasks.details:
- Check VITE_API_URL environment variable in frontend
- Verify backend CORS configuration allows frontend origin
- Test OPTIONS preflight requests
- Check network tab in browser devtools
- Verify API base URL matches backend server port
- Test with both localhost and 127.0.0.1
tasks.testStrategy: Start both frontend and backend servers, monitor network requests in browser devtools, verify successful API calls

tasks.title: 3. Test Frontend Registration Form Integration
tasks.description: Test the complete registration flow from the frontend UI, ensuring form data is properly sent to the backend and responses are correctly handled.
tasks.details:
- Test RegisterPage.tsx form submission
- Verify form validation (email, password, name)
- Test admission number input
- Test manual verification flow
- Check AuthContext register function
- Verify apiService.register() method
- Test success/error toast notifications
- Check navigation after registration
tasks.testStrategy: Fill out registration form in browser, submit, verify API calls in network tab, check toast notifications and navigation

tasks.title: 4. Test User Login Flow
tasks.description: Verify complete login functionality including authentication, token management, and user session handling.
tasks.details:
- Test login endpoint /api/auth/login
- Verify JWT token generation and storage
- Test access token and refresh token flow
- Check user data storage in localStorage
- Test AuthContext login function
- Verify navigation based on user role
- Test "remember me" functionality if exists
- Check protected route access after login
tasks.testStrategy: Register a test user, login with credentials, verify tokens in localStorage, check protected routes access

tasks.title: 5. Integrate User Profile Management
tasks.description: Connect frontend profile pages with backend profile APIs to allow users to view and update their profiles.
tasks.details:

- Test PUT /api/users/:id endpoint
- Connect ProfilePage.tsx with backend APIs
- Implement profile image upload
- Test profile update functionality
- Verify authorization for profile updates
- Handle profile data validation
tasks.testStrategy: Login as user, navigate to profile page, update profile fields, verify changes persist in database

tasks.details:

- Test DELETE /api/posts/:id endpoint (delete post)
- Connect PostsPage.tsx with backend APIs
- Implement post creation form
- Implement post editing functionality
- Add post deletion with confirmation
- Test pagination and filtering
tasks.testStrategy: Create, read, update, and delete posts through UI, verify operations in database, test pagination
